keyPhrases.text: wasting disease going around the theater district
boy, does The Snow Geese have a bad case of it
You could do worse than model your play on Chekhov
easy to miss the big ideas for the birds
lacks two qualities whose absence can't be finessed
gives us a play we feel like we've already seen

reasoning: Harsh review with extended disease metaphor comparing play to 'Chekhovitis.' Critic systematically dismantles the work, citing lack of originality, poor character development, structural problems, and derivative plotting. No genuine praise offered - even positive phrases are backhanded compliments.
